name: ENBrowser v0.4.4
body:
## Install

- **Ubuntu 22.04+**: `sudo apt install ./ENBrowser_0.4.4_amd64.deb` (installs `tor` too), or run the AppImage.
- **Windows 10/11**: run `ENBrowser_0.4.4_x64-setup.exe` (not tested on Windows yet; Tor is Linux-only for now).

Your presets, bookmarks, history and settings are kept when you update.

## What's new

- **Sleeping tabs.** A background tab you have not looked at for 15 minutes stops using memory. It keeps its place and title, and it loads again when you open it. A tab playing sound stays awake. You can change the time, or turn this off, in *Settings → Advanced → Sleeping tabs*.
- **Faster start with many tabs.** Tabs from the last session wait until you open them, instead of all loading at once.
- **No more black flashes.** While the window grows, or a busy page catches up, the empty area shows the theme colour instead of black.
- **Lighter pages** now also turns off the glass blur in the tab bar and toolbar.
- **New app icon** from the new EN family icon set.
